scope: Bounded read-only review of the WIP source_conversion_io.py for unsafe acquisition/finally named-edge gaps, partial complete-set capture, mirror creation and exception tracking, link rejection, resource bounds, and performance. No source, test, Git, Vault, network, or external-process mutation.

findings.title: Retained session safety errors escape the direct conversion API
findings.evidence: _verify_all catches only ContractError and OSError, while _RetainedBatchSession.verify raises StagingError for checkout/.work/batch lineage failures. validator_mirror invokes _verify_all([mirror, parent, session]) in its finally block. A session-only race can therefore escape as StagingError; convert_source_knowledge's _boundary does not catch StagingError, even though the CLI catches it.
findings.required_fix: Normalize all named lower-level safety exceptions through the conversion boundary while preserving their code, pointer/details, and exit code; continue checking the remaining held objects before raising the first safety failure.

findings.title: Foreign mirror slots and creation collisions are not fail-closed
findings.evidence: Fresh nonce creation and mirror mkdir call os.mkdir directly, so a foreign nonce or raced directory/file raises FileExistsError or another OSError and the conversion boundary maps a bare OSError to SOURCE_CONVERSION_INVALID. A foreign differing install relies on _atomic_install's STAGING_CONFLICT, which RetainedTree.install does not convert. These slots must never be adopted or reported as ordinary conversion invalidity.
findings.required_fix: Map nonce/mkdir/install collisions and unexpected occupied private mirror slots to WORK_PATH_UNSAFE, retaining the existing refusal for a reused identical slot.

findings.title: Partial acquisition does not retain all observed sibling identities
findings.evidence: capture records a directory's names but records each file identity only immediately before reading that file. If acquisition stops on a size/entry/unsafe failure, later siblings and their identities/bytes are absent from self.files and are not rechecked by the finally verification. R1 requires early failure to verify all acquired invariants; a prepass over every safe sibling identity is needed before any file reads to make complete-set tracking meaningful on partial acquisition.
findings.required_fix: Record every safe sibling stat/identity in a directory prepass before reading files, retain exact bytes for successfully read files, and verify all prepass identities/sets on every exit.

positive_checks: safe_path validates spelling before normalization; retained descriptors use no-follow opens.
NFC and casefold collision checks, symlink/special-file rejection, hardlink checks, entry/depth/file/total bounds, and exact rereads are present.
The generated mirror is nonce-named, privately created, retained through validation, and its complete set and bytes are verified before yield and in finally.
The bounded limits (8192 entries, depth 16, 16 MiB per file, 128 MiB total) keep the descriptor-relative verification cost bounded; no independent performance blocker was found.
